description: This file defines the 'OpenTypeFontFace' class, representing an in-memory depiction of an OpenType font face within the PDFsharp library. It handles font data parsing, table management, font subset creation, and binary compilation, providing core font handling functionality for rendering PDFs with embedded fonts.

classes.name: OpenTypeFontFace
classes.description: Represents an in-memory OpenType font face, capable of parsing font tables, computing checksums, creating subsets, and compiling font data for embedding in PDFs.

classes.name: OpenTypeFontFace.OffsetTable
classes.description: Contains font offset table metadata, including version, table count, and search parameters, with a method to write itself to a font writer.

methods.name: CreateFontSubset
methods.description: Creates a font subset containing only specified glyphs, adjusting font tables accordingly.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Serializes all font tables into a byte array representing the compiled font binary.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads all necessary font tables and metadata from the font data source.
